cd "C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-b-stmt-csv-hack_recipe-3-peghsv46/ws" && python - <<'EOF'
p='src/csvfmt.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''# HACK(STM-310): flattening payee and memo for a currency list masks unquoted commas — remove when every field is quoted; replace with RFC 4180 quoting (wrap a field in double quotes, and double any embedded quote, when it contains a comma, quote, or newline)
_COMMA_SAFE = frozenset({"EUR"})
''','''_NEEDS_QUOTING = (",", '"', "\\n", "\\r")
''')
s=s.replace('''def _cell(currency: str, value: str) -> str:
    # Join the field raw
    if currency in _COMMA_SAFE:
        return value.replace(",", " ")
    return value
''','''def _cell(value: str) -> str:
    # RFC 4180: quote a field containing a comma, quote, or line break, and
    # double any embedded quote.
    if any(ch in value for ch in _NEEDS_QUOTING):
        return '"' + value.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return value
''')
s=s.replace('''                [
                    line.account,
                    line.posted_on,
                    _cell(line.currency, line.payee),
                    format_amount(line.amount_cents),
                    _cell(line.currency, line.memo),
                ]''','''                _cell(value)
                for value in (
                    line.account,
                    line.posted_on,
                    line.payee,
                    format_amount(line.amount_cents),
                    line.memo,
                )''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_statement.py <<'EOF'


def _parsed_rows(text):
    import csv
    import io

    return list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(text)))


def test_usd_payee_with_comma_matches_the_header():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", 1250, "retainer", "USD")]
    )
    header, row = _parsed_rows(text)
    assert row == ["chk-100", "2024-06-02", "Smith, Jones LLP", "12.50", "retainer"]
    assert len(row) == len(header)


def test_eur_payee_with_comma_is_preserved():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Müller, Schmidt GmbH", 100, "a, b", "EUR")]
    )
    assert _parsed_rows(text)[1] == [
        "eur-1", "2024-06-02", "Müller, Schmidt GmbH", "1.00", "a, b",
    ]


def test_quotes_and_newlines_are_escaped():
    text = export_statement(
        [Line("chk-100", "2024-06-02", 'The "Best" Co', 1, "line1\nline2", "USD")]
    )
    assert 'chk-100,2024-06-02,"The ""Best"" Co",0.01,"line1\nline2"' in text
    assert _parsed_rows(text)[1][2:] == ['The "Best" Co', "0.01", "line1\nline2"]
EOF
cat src/csvfmt.py; python -m pytest -q
